g.text: If DTR is LOW, toggling RTS from HIGH to LOW resets to run mode. If RTS is HIGH, toggling DTR from LOW to HIGH resets to bootloader.

RF Track Impedance: Coplanar Waveguide with Ground Calculations Ground is on layer 2. Prepreg thickness: 0.2mm. Er = 4.6 12.5 mil track with 5 mil gap = 50 Ohms https://chemandy.com/calculators/coplanar-waveguide-with-ground-calculator.htm
Open jumper V_TP to set output to 5V
IO0: Avoid device connections. Can be used a stat LED.
IO5: Has builtin pullup at POR.
Vin Max: 6.0V Iout Max: 700mA Vdo: 120mV @ 330mA Output Discharge: 530Ω Typ
IO2: Avoid external pullups - will cause bootloader fail.
IO15: Has builtin pullup at POR.
Vin Max: 6.0V Iout Max: 700mA Vdo: 120mV @ 330mA Output Discharge: 530Ω Typ
USB Track Impedance: Differential Pair https://saturnpcb.com/saturn-pcb-toolkit/ Prepreg thickness: 0.2mm (7.87 mil). Er = 4.6 10.5 mil track with 9.5 mil gap (20 mil center to center) = 90 Ohms
Use boot control pins with caution: 0, 2, 5, 12, 15
ADC2 is unavailable when WiFi is enabled.
IO12: Avoid external pullups - will cause bootloader fail.
